opportunities.title: Fulbright Scholar Awards to the USA (UK Scholars)

amount.raw: Monthly stipends vary by award; e.g. Elon University $5,000/month, Rutgers University-Newark $5,000/month, Royal College of Surgeons of England £2,275/month, National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship stipend to cover living expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based academics and other professionals. UK citizens, or non-UK citizens based in and committed to a life and career in the UK who cannot apply through their country of citizenship. Preference given to applicants without extensive (6+ months) prior US experience.
opportunities.summary: Provides the only scholarships available to UK-based academics and other professionals to lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university. Grant periods typically last 3-6 months, with some partner awards up to an academic year. Includes monthly stipends, sickness and accident coverage, visa support, cultural enrichment, and alumni network access. Partner awards include All Disciplines, Elon University, Royal College of Surgeons of England, Rutgers University-Newark, Royal Society of Edinburgh, and Fulbright-National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship.
